g.text: User verification at every key step (Extraction, Save, Automation).
Preview first (free). AI is only called when user intends to extract.
No auto-save in Accounting software. Manual confirmation required.
Retry logic -> Manual entry mode fallback.
Pause automation -> Show user manual copy/paste guide.
Flag for mandatory review. Disable automation until fixed.

svg.text: MAAS - Mom's Accounting Automation System | Design Document V2.0 | December 2025
